changeSet.author: Sebastian Abraham
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE t1 SET t1.AssetID = t2.[ID] FROM dbo.fusionowner AS t1 INNER JOIN dbo.Asset AS t2 ON t1.ArtifactID = t2.[ObjectID] and t2.[Object] ='Artifact'
IF EXISTS(Select 1 from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS where constraint_name ='PK_FusionOwner') BEGIN Alter table FusionOwner drop constraint PK_FusionOwner END
IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_NAME ='FK_FusionOwner_Artifact') BEGIN Alter table FusionOwner drop constraint FK_FusionOwner_Artifact END
Alter table FusionOwner alter column AssetID bigint not null
Alter table FusionOwner alter column ArtifactID int null
IF NOT EXISTS(Select 1 from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS where constraint_name ='PK_FusionOwner') BEGIN Alter table FusionOwner ADD CONSTRAINT PK_FusionOwner PRIMARY KEY (FusionID, AssetID) END
changeSet.rollback:
Alter table FusionOwner drop constraint PK_FusionOwner
Alter table FusionOwner alter column AssetID bigint null
Alter table FusionOwner alter column ArtifactID int not null
ALTER TABLE FusionOwner ADD CONSTRAINT FK_FusionOwner_Artifact FOREIGN KEY (ArtifactID) REFERENCES Artifact (ID)
Alter table FusionOwner ADD CONSTRAINT PK_FusionOwner PRIMARY KEY (FusionID, ArtifactID)
